question: A same-vendor reviewer noted that the classical Gijswijt–Schrijver–Tanaka q-ary code SDP contains constraints absent from AMH Eq31: 0 <= x_(i,j)^(t,p) <= x_(i,0)^(0,0) and a second PSD family with entries x_(i+j-t-p,0)^(0,0) - x_(i,j)^(t,p). A genuine [[24,0,10]] stabilizer is a classical additive F4 code of size 2^24, so these are additional necessary conditions for an actual code's pair enumerator.
method: Parent session using the independent checker's orbit, gamma, binary-factor and colour-polynomial functions. Blocks scaled by D^-1 M D^-1 with D=diag(3^(i/2)), giving exact rational coefficients beta*colour_poly[p]/3^t, so odd i+j entries are handled without square roots. PSD by exact rational Gram decomposition with separate reconstruction.
interpretation: The integral table also satisfies these classical GST necessary constraints. So this route gives no nonexistence obstruction at this point; it does not imply code existence. The transcription of the GST second family is from the reviewer's pointer and standard form, not from a newly opened GST source in this session.
